stories.title: Nestlé duplicará su inversión en México durante sexenio de Sheinbaum

en.title: Nestlé will double its investment in Mexico during Sheinbaum's administration
en.summary: Nestlé's CEO Philipp Navratil met with Mexico's president to discuss expansion plans. The company announced it will double its investment in Mexico over the coming years.

en.title: Hurricane 'Simon' intensifies to Category 1
en.summary: Hurricane Simon strengthened to Category 1 status with maximum sustained winds of 120 km/h, located 380 km south of Manzanillo.

stories.title: Sheinbaum anuncia que Nestlé duplicará inversión a 2 mil mdp en México; se reúne con CEO, Philipp Navratil

en.title: Sheinbaum announces Nestlé will double investment to 2 billion pesos in Mexico; meets with CEO Philipp Navratil
en.summary: Nestlé plans to double its investment to 2 billion pesos in Mexico between 2028 and 2030, focusing on coffee production expansion involving 70,000 plants and 2,000 producers in Veracruz.

stories.title: Da Morena, ahora, candidatura a Célida en Hermosillo

en.title: Morena now gives Célida the candidacy for Hermosillo
en.summary: Morena party appointed Célida López as its coordinator for Hermosillo's municipal government after she failed to secure the Sonora gubernatorial nomination.

stories.title: Morena designa a Célia López como coordinadora municipal de Hermosillo; perdió contra Lorenia candidatura de Sonora

en.title: Morena appoints Célia López as municipal coordinator of Hermosillo; lost to Lorenia in Sonora candidacy
en.summary: Mexico's Morena party has appointed Célia López as municipal coordinator for Hermosillo. The party's national elections committee stated the appointment aims to strengthen territorial organization.

stories.title: Aluvión e intensas lluvias en Chile dejan 6 heridos y autos atrapados; declaran zona de catástrofe

en.title: Flooding and heavy rains in Chile leave 6 injured and cars trapped; disaster zone declared
en.summary: Heavy rains and flooding in Chile have caused six injuries and trapped vehicles, with the Las Condes area in northeast Santiago particularly affected. Authorities declared the area a disaster zone.

stories.title: Aluvión en Chile arrastra vehículos e inunda viviendas por fuertes lluvias; Kast declara estado de catástrofe

en.title: Flooding in Chile sweeps away vehicles and floods homes from heavy rains; Kast declares state of catastrophe
en.summary: A torrent of water, mud, and rocks caused by heavy rains damaged streets, homes, and vehicles in northeast Santiago, isolating a university. The government declared a state of catastrophe.

stories.title: DHS llama "criminal dominicano" a hombre herido por ICE en Nueva York; asegura que tiene condenas por agresión y drogas

en.title: DHS calls man injured by ICE in New York "Dominican criminal"; claims he has assault and drug convictions
en.summary: The U.S. Department of Homeland Security identified a man injured during an ICE incident in New York as a convicted criminal with drug and assault charges, alleging ties to the Trinitarios gang.

stories.title: Agente de ICE hiere de bala a un hombre durante operativo en el Bronx, Nueva York

en.title: ICE agent shoots man during operation in the Bronx, New York
en.summary: An ICE agent fired shots at a man during an operation in the Bronx. The injured person was taken to a nearby hospital where he remains conscious and receiving medical care.

stories.title: Huracán Isaías se intensifica a categoría 2 en su camino a EU; tormenta Simon se aproxima al occidente de México

en.title: Hurricane Isaías intensifies to category 2 heading toward US; storm Simon approaches western Mexico
en.summary: Hurricane Isaías strengthened to category 2 while moving toward the United States. Tropical storm Simon threatens to rapidly develop into a hurricane off Mexican coasts.

stories.title: Riña en penal de Mazatlán deja saldo de al menos 10 muertos y 16 heridos

en.title: Prison riot in Mazatlán leaves at least 10 dead and 16 injured
en.summary: A violent altercation at a Mazatlán prison facility resulted in at least 10 deaths and 16 injuries. Military and police personnel deployed with heavy equipment to restore order at the facility.

stories.title: Deja 10 muertos y 16 heridos riña en penal de Mazatlán

en.title: Prison riot in Mazatlán leaves 10 dead and 16 injured
en.summary: A riot at El Castillo prison in Mazatlán resulted in 10 deaths including one family visitor and 16 inmates injured.

stories.title: Ascensos sin aumento de sueldo, ¿por qué puedes asumir un nuevo puesto sin ganar más dinero?

en.title: Promotions without salary increases: why you might take a new position without earning more money
en.summary: Promotions can advance job titles without corresponding pay raises. Aon discusses how companies should evaluate new positions and adjust compensation when job responsibilities change.

stories.title: Cierre de Directo a México de Banxico: las apps y el dinero digital cambian el manejo de las remesas

en.title: Closure of Directo a México from Banxico: apps and digital money reshape remittance handling
en.summary: Technology is transforming how remittances are managed, with digital applications and electronic money replacing traditional bank transfers.

stories.title: Nafin e IP quieren descarbonizar las cadenas de valor en México

en.title: Nafin and IP seek to decarbonize supply chains in Mexico
en.summary: A development bank and private industry are pursuing decarbonization in supply chains as a strategy to improve competitiveness and access to global markets.

stories.title: Tu cara como pasaporte: aeropuertos y empresas turísticas impulsan la biometría facial como identificación

en.title: Your face as a passport: airports and tourism companies advance facial biometrics for identification
en.summary: The tourism industry is implementing facial biometric technology for traveler identification, working to integrate airports, airlines, authorities, and hospitality services into a connected digital system.

stories.title: Las empresas que pagan menos ISR usan hasta 10% de facturas falsas, dice el SAT

en.title: Companies paying least ISR use up to 10% fake invoices, says SAT
en.summary: Mexico's tax authority reports that companies with lower tax payments use fraudulent invoices, harming tax equity. Large companies pay an average effective ISR rate of 1% compared to salaried workers paying over 20%.
